verdict.rationale: BugSnag has no documented natural-language command interface of its own. It does ship an official MCP server (SmartBear MCP), including a self-hosted variant with OAuth 2.0 login, so users can operate BugSnag through natural language in an AI client. That natural-language layer comes from the external agent, and the MCP server's operations are not detailed. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language or assistant interface, documentation of which actions can be performed via natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
